Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, SQLite, DuckDB, Trino Starburst, Firebase, Supabase. g.text: ★ Knives: the languages I write the most code in, from my repos. The rest is my resume; the rarer, the more I use it.
